claims.claim: The game features realistic soft-body physics and real-time crash damage simulation.

citations.review_text:
**The ultimate driving sandbox**

BeamNG.drive is hands down one of the most impressive driving games out there. The vehicle physics and soft-body damage simulation are incredible, and the level of detail in how vehicles handle, deform, and react to their surroundings is something you really have to experience for yourself.

What makes this game so enjoyable is the freedom. Whether you want to cruise around, race, explore, haul trailers, test vehicles, or just see what happens when you push a car beyond its limits, there's always something to do.

The modding community adds even more to an already fantastic experience. With countless vehicles, maps, scenarios, and other content available, there's practically endless replayability.

It's not just a racing game. It's a driving sandbox where you can make your own fun and experiment with just about anything.

If you enjoy cars, driving, realistic vehicle physics, or just messing around with vehicles, BeamNG.drive is absolutely worth owning.

**Highly recommended!**

BeamNG.drive stands out as a masterpiece in the gaming world because of its revolutionary soft-body physics engine. Unlike traditional racing games that rely on pre-baked animations for crashes, this simulator calculates the physical behavior of every vehicle component in real time. This means that a collision at fifty miles per hour bends steel, shatters glass, and twists frames with absolute realism, making every driving error feel impactful and visually spectacular.
Beyond its industry-leading destruction, the game provides a deeply rewarding driving simulation. The meticulous attention to weight distribution, tire grip, and suspension geometry creates an authentic experience that rivals dedicated racing simulators. Whether you are navigating a high-speed track, crawling over treacherous rocks, or delivering cargo in a heavy semi-truck, the vehicle handling feels incredibly organic and responsive.
Furthermore, its vast open-ended sandbox nature grants players ultimate freedom. With a massive library of official and community-made vehicles, extensive tuning options, and an active modding scene, the possibilities are virtually limitless. BeamNG.drive is not just a game about crashing cars; it is the ultimate playground for automotive enthusiasts, offering unparalleled realism, depth, and creative freedom.

claims.claim: Default controller bindings and presets are unpolished or misconfigured.

citations.review_text:
I played this before whatever the utter living f happened to the controller bindings. 

So the game sees the dualsense edge's input as followed (as i press them, in the game's test devices feature, will be listing what is wrong only) square as triangle, x as square, circle as x, triangle as circle, R2 as right joystick up and down axis, L2 as right joystick left and right axis, right joystick up and down axis as R2 (centered is both L2 and R2 as pressed to half), right joystick left and right axis as L2, R3 as guide, L3 as R3, the buttons under my joysticks don't register, as well as the paddles under the controller don't register either. This is with a Dualsense Edge, and Dualsense controller.

I know I'm smooth brained af, but this makes it feel like someone was even more smooth than me for once.

I have been playing beamng since the first tech demos...  I almost miss the old tech demos. We keep getting new vehicals and features but they seem to keep getting more and more agrivating to use. All the ui feels patched onto the game like a bad mod slow laggy etc. a hoge gripe is controller support technically you can play this with a controller but the default controller presets are near unusable and I let that go before but I cant belive its still an issue. 

The new campign seemed really cool with how it gives you spare body panels if you crash and go through insurance like they are unprimed panels and without a doubt the best upgrade platform a game has ever seen. This is all nullified by them not polishing the core game years ago and just slapping more and more stuff to it. They seem to be aiming to make this a game but the issue is it is a glorified tech demo modded to be a game.

There is huge potential but beamng is just getting cumbersom to play on a controller with all these new additions. 

Please beamng team go back to the basics and fix the core gameplay before adding more

claims.claim: The game includes a split-screen multiplayer feature.

citations.review_text:
I grew up with Gran Turismo, Flatout 2 and GTA games. More than 10 years ago when Bugbear (flatout 2) put Next Car Game (Wreckfest) into early access they threw in a sort of sandbox side game that let you play with soft bodied cars.  It wasn't until a couple of years later that I found and fell in love with Beam.NG which far surpassed anything in Wreckfest.

A decade later and still being in early access might sound like a joke, but it really isn't.  It has been a pleasure following and enjoying the game's development. 

But since my first time running the game, a feature was very sorely missing.  A feature I spent many hours trying to, and was unsuccessful in achieving was SPLIT-SCREEN.  Now with this latest update bam, a quite comprehensive split-screen implementation for Beam.NG, right there in the top of my news feed. 

This game has always been worth the buy, but it still just keeps getting better and better.

Could never get bored! Best game I've had in years, been on it for a couple of years and it's just get better and better. Can't believe the amount of work that has to go into this project by such a small team.
Well done! Casual gamer here, 90% racing games, this is what I keep returning to. Race, drift, rally, off-road, cruise, crash. It really has it all. Modding community is strong and considering it's PS5 release recently I would assume as more player jump on the community will only grow. Also, split-screen, why it went away in games, who knows? What a wellcome feature to reintroduce.

This game easily takes the first spot on the list of the best driving simulators in the world. It is straight up a 10/10 game.

First, it is more then just building the fastest racecar, you can just easily get lost inside the game and not realize, that you've been playing it for 3-5 hours straight. You can customize your car to the near absolute limits, and fine tune it too, or just use the provided defaults.

Second, it is the developers, who simply can't fail to amaze me with the updates. For example, in 0.40, the new EU truck drives and feels better then the ones in ETS2.

Third, it is the absolute attention down to the last details, that gets me too: from the (normally unseen) tire springs being realistically animated, to the fact, that you can now even simulate the whole sky, it is just feels nearly irl. Third, it is the mods: you can, for example, play flight sim in this game too. Or drive anything. It really feels like the ultimate sandbox, to do anything you want. Or play multiplayer, for example.

Four. Physics. You can destroy everything. Besides the map, for now. This game is the very likely to be the closest to real life in terms of vehicle physics.

Five. There are really fun missions in the game, although I cannot make a full review on that because I haven't played that much of them. The ones I played were fun though. There is also split screen multiplayer, to game.

Six. Performance. From my experience, you can run this game on a potato and have fun with it too, but I do recommend a stronger PC for it, as if you'd like to enjoy the beatiful graphics this game has to offer, you are going to need one. Also, with update 0.39 and 0.40, the performance even got better, thanks to upscaling being introduced.

Seven. This game is in early access... (we'll perhaps have a simulation of real life when 1.0 comes out). I think, that the developers of this game deserve really much for giving this much to this game, and really giving attention, down to the last deta…

This is definitely one of the best video games (best vehicle game) of all time! You could say I'm overexaggerating, but it's really worth it! The game has amazing crash physics, a decent vehicle variety, split-screen, amazing graphics, etc! I'm really impressed with how much detail and effort the BeamNG devs put into this game, and they still are to this day!

Also worth mentioning that the game being 24 bucks is a way better deal than getting Forza Horizon 6 for around 60 bucks...

I bought this game 4 years ago on my other PC and had so much fun, I bought it 2 years ago on this PC and still have so much fun. The game is absolutely amazing, the graphics with 0.39 and 0.40 make it look real (sometimes too real) and the selection of cars are great. You have boxtrucks, normal trucks, coupes, sedans, wagons, vans, I could go on and on. The sounds are quite good, the turbo makes funny noise so they have to be good ;) and the ambiance is nice. There are some small bugs in the base game and sometimes lots with mods but, it's mods. The physics are great with a wheel and the new split screen means I can play with my friends too. I don't have anything bad to say about this game, it's great and I love it. The one thing bad about this though is that it is quite demanding so low frames are expected, especially with the graphics. If you have a low end PC you may want to save your money for a better one instead of spending money on a game you can't run yet. The game will get progressively better and better so BUY IT NOW BEFORE IT'S 700 BUCKS BECAUSE IT'S THE BEST GAME ON STEAM. One last thing, the scammers for this game are insane. If you see a scam of BeamNG.drive please report it, we need to wipe the community of scammers and harmful people out of BeamNG's way so they have less to worry about. Also don't buy Steam Keys of this game, even if it is cheaper. Don't do it because every key sold BeamNG has to get fined and pay the bank money because the seller is technically selling illegal copies of the game. If everyone buys BeamNG off of outside retailers, the devs get fined and if they run out of money, NO MORE BEAMNG. Thanks for reading the review and no unauthorized retailers!
